User: Wanting to do delivery in comparison to driving there.
Agent: Understood. So, opting for delivery instead of driving is the primary change when you're in convenience mode.

Now, thinking about your most recent fast-food order, what triggered it today? Was it a craving, a deal, an ad, someone suggested it, you were nearby, time pressure, you wanted something lighter, or you wanted a treat? Also, was it planned or spontaneous, and what would have had to change for you to not get fast food today?
